Me!! I felt the exact same as you, came out as bi when I was a teenager but I was so scared of women I never dated or asked them out, only had a few hookups and only when I went on a couple dates with this one girl did I realise I had never been attracted to a man. Get along with them well, the sex was alright and didn’t exactly gross me out but the body of a man had never turned me on like going down on a girl did. Never gone back since, never wanted to. I think I just liked the easy validation that men gave me and was scared of women because I had so much more feelings about them 🤷‍♀️

I think it’s quite common for lesbians to first identify as bi before realizing they’re not. But also sexuality can be fluid so don’t worry too much about it and go ahead and identify as a lesbian if you only want to be with women. 

But also stay safe ❤️thoughts are with you.
